args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of the four-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder (35+45+45+35 m, deck 12.5 m, single-cell box h=2.2 m).

Key modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, elastic beam-column elements (MR-01); system = continuous_on_piers (MR-05), since pier column geometry was given.
- Girder: cast_box section integrated → A = 6.712 m², I = 4.4982 m⁴; C50 → Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG3362-3.1.5); γ = 26 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1); self-weight only w = 174.512 kN/m, mass m = 17.789 t/m (MR-07).
- Supports (numbered 0–4): abutments 0 & 4 and piers 1 & 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (longitudinally free, Kh = 0, per MR-03); pier 2 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed bearing (longitudinal spring, Kh = 13090.9 kN/m). Two bearings per line; Ge = 1.2 MPa (manufacturer value, MR-00). Shape factors S and vertical stiffnesses Kv computed per JTG3362-8.7 (S = 10.10–14.69; Kv = 3.61–8.97×10⁶ kN/m).
- Piers (MR-06): twin Ø1.8 m C40 columns, combined A = 5.0894 m², I = 1.0306 m⁴, Ec = 32500 MPa; lengths 26, 10, 29 m; base fixed.
- Traffic (JTG D60-2015): Class I, one-way, 3 lanes → qk = 10.5 kN/m, ξ = 0.78, Pk = 330/350/350/330 kN by span.

Results: first vertical bending frequency f1 = 2.660 Hz (→ impact factor μ = 0.157, JTGD60-4.3.2). Self-weight support reactions 2266 / 7701 / 7988 / 7699 / 2267 kN; max lane-load positive moment 11539 kNm (span 3), max negative moment −9597 kNm (support 2). The model passed the L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks.
